selection_basis: all 29 parent spans from the source scaffold
all candidates from the three semantic atom bundles
exact source line and source span digest recheck
global candidate ID and source-line deduplication

connection_rules.parent_coverage: one exact source-line edge for each candidate
connection_rules.product_boundary: preserve every candidate_product or candidate_product_candidates value as candidate-only edge
connection_rules.phase: promote only an exact parent or atom identifier in a dedicated ID/link field of PHCAP; otherwise unlinked_unknown
connection_rules.implementation_asset: promote only an exact parent or atom identifier in a dedicated ID/link field of the implementation crosswalk; otherwise unlinked_unknown
connection_rules.description_text: free-text or unrelated JSON fields never establish a direct link

stop_conditions: do not create formal requirement units or product assignments
do not infer phase, implementation, degradation, failure, or consumer status
do not execute archive runtime, test, CI, workflow, hook, adapter, or source
